---
name: 🚀 Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for CatchBug
title: "[FEAT] <concise description>"
labels: ["enhancement", "proposal"]
assignees: ""
---

## 💡 Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem or developer pain point? Please describe clearly.
*Example: "I'm always frustrated when I need to export reports to Linear or Jira Cloud..."*

## 🌟 Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you would like to see implemented in CatchBug.

## 🎨 UI / UX Considerations
If applicable, describe how this affects the UI (Floating dock, Control Center, Annotation Canvas, Export Modal).

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 🛡️ Security / Privacy Implications
Does this feature interact with browser telemetry, user credentials, network traffic, or external APIs? If so, how should data privacy and credential masking be handled?

## 📝 Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
